parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing positives: no criminalisation of gender identity or gender expression; a 2024 hate-crimes statute expressly covering gender identity; an Equality Court ruling (Nov 2025) enforcing care and gender-expression rights for a detained trans woman; a tavern assault with an arrest reported. Negatives: the facility-access question is contested and unresolved for visitors; a 2024 academic analysis argues trans people lack equal protection in facilities; a 2024 report documents police mocking a trans woman seeking help after showing ID; document mismatch is linked to denial of service and fraud-arrest threats; prison-care implementation is doubted. Violence: the only trans-specific incident is single and dated, and the five-murder count has no denominator, so it is not used. Township violence is an undated prevalence claim. Public opinion is dated and not trans-specific. Visitor border screening is undocumented, an open question. Net: Reduced Risk, held down by unresolved facility exposure and police hostility.
